# Juan David Moreno Alfonso | Software Engineer in Colombia

## Core Skills
React, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Kotlin, Go, AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway, CloudFront
Functions), Terraform, PostgreSQL, serverless architecture, frontend performance and Core Web Vitals,
technical SEO, GSAP motion design, Retrieval-Augmented Generation.

## Selected Impact
- At Truora: cut manual identity review time from 60s to 30s without lowering data quality; improved
  data extraction and validation for Colombian driver's licenses at InDrive, with an expected $500K in
  Annual Recurring Revenue. Interviews engineering candidates and mentors interns on the team.
- At Cressco: improved joshwoodcolour.com initial load time by ~20% and strengthened its SEO; built an
  autosave feature for Reddocares forms that eliminated user data loss.

## Projects
- [Josh Wood Colour](https://juandamoreno.dev/projects/josh-wood-colour) - Headless Shopify store for a UK premium hair colour brand, built with Gatsby 5, React and Storyblok at Cressco; ~20% faster loads and fixed email deliverability.
- [Juanda Bot](https://juandamoreno.dev/projects/juandabot) - Python Telegram assistant for the thesis platform: public build on python-telegram-bot, Flask and Groq Llama 3 (Render); private build on n8n workflows with RAG, Ollama and OpenAI/Groq fallbacks.
- [Lambda Lang](https://juandamoreno.dev/projects/lambda-lang) - Programming language and interpreter built in Racket with the EOPL toolkit (sllgen scanner/parser, AST, environment-based evaluator, objects and methods, REPL). Team of four, Universidad del Valle.
- [Patitas a Casa](https://juandamoreno.dev/projects/patitas-a-casa) - Volunteer pet adoption platform in Mendoza, Argentina: React, Vite and TypeScript frontend with an Express and MongoDB API; adoption and lost-and-found listings for shelters.
- [My Portfolio](https://juandamoreno.dev/projects/portfolio) - Creative, motion-driven portfolio showing motion design, performance, and structure.
- [My Thesis](https://juandamoreno.dev/projects/thesis) - Undergraduate thesis at Universidad del Valle (2025): AI platform with FastAPI, React, Whisper and Llama 3 for oratory and critical-thinking training; 95% usability approval. Official record: https://hdl.handle.net/10893/39431 - Demo: https://trabajo-de-grado-2-front.vercel.app/
